description: Short interest history for a Nasdaq-listed stock from Nasdaq.com (FINRA twice-monthly settlement data): settlement date, shares sold short, average daily share volume and days to cover, newest first (about one year of reports), plus the change versus the previous report. Only Nasdaq-listed symbols are supported by the source. Related tools on this server, for a different need: finance_ofr_short_term_funding_monitor when you need OFR Short-term Funding Monitor daily series from the US. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: finance_nasdaq_short_interest
title: Short interest history for a Nasdaq-listed stock
